title: fetch_question result
description: One shape for every outcome. An empty bank is exhausted:true with null question fields, not an error and not a throw. referenceAnswer is deliberately absent: a model holding the model answer paraphrases it into its follow-ups, which destroys the question. aiSrc is absent for a different reason: it is a video URL for the CLIENT, and the interviewer can do nothing with it except pay for it in every prompt that quotes this result back.

question.description: The question text to put to the candidate. Null when exhausted.

exhausted.description: True when the bank has no question left that satisfies the request.

remaining.description: Unserved questions left in the bank after this call.
